supporting_observations.claim: The recorded account creation occurred at 13:47:06 UTC, by ruth.moss, rather than exactly at the alert's approximate 13:42 time.
The account name c.rwong matches the stated temporary-account naming convention, and ruth.moss is the recorded creator.
The new account was added to the Seasonal group by ruth.moss, consistent with the stated temporary-account practice.
A Kerberos network logon for ruth.moss from 10.54.10.24 occurred shortly before the creation; its logon ID matches the subject logon ID on the account-creation and group-add events.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy log collection was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:10 UTC. The available account-creation and group-membership events are Windows security records; this proxy gap does not establish whether the account activity was authorized.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether a help-desk request or other approval specifically authorized creating c.rwong.
The evidence shows a Seasonal group addition but does not provide a complete account-group membership listing or establish all subsequent account use.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox.exe ran under ruth.moss on WS-RMOSS-01; Dropbox is not among the organization's approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services. Investigate separately; this does not determine the disposition of the c.rwong account activity. (T218-00009, T218-00010, T218-00011)
